versionPairs.description: A plain Bun app (Bun 1.3.14, `bun build --target=bun --format=cjs`, unminified): six ES modules imported statically, a local CommonJS dep and the real npm package ms@2.1.3. Bun writes NO lazy-init module, so the bundle records no module markers: the split takes the fresh grouping (on main it chose the marker method by BUNDLER and exited 1 after naming — finding C1). Generated by ../bun-apps (gen.mjs + build.sh). v1.1.0 changes the palette and archive reports and adds a function to the CommonJS dep.
